title: A spark at dusk

scenes.title: Village lit one road at a time
scenes.purpose: An idea (one lit window) becomes a connected system: roads and repainted light link the village under a painted dusk sky.
visuals: Stationary dusk sky of horizontal comma streaks (violet to rose to peach)
Dim slate-teal hill underpainting and dark foreground band
Sun repainted with tangential dabs plus two dashed halo rings
Four brick houses, roads of rut strokes, window sparks and glow pools
Cream title card with serif copy

beats.development: Title card is readable from the first frame. Cypress flame strokes paint upward, the sun is repainted from its core outward, halo rings sweep around it, and the houses are brushed onto the hill.
captions: lights the whole village, one road at a time

beats.development: Spark: the first house window flares and settles into a warm glow. Teal light repaints the hill outward from it, and the first road paints toward house two.
House two lights; two roads branch to house three, which lights at 1.95 s, then a road heads for house four. Each light spreads its own repaint across the land.
The last house lights and its repaint completes by 2.65 s. The whole lit, connected village then holds still.

findings: Copy is static and legible for the full 3 s; the stroke reveals stay outside the card.
Each light-up is a distinct cue, about 0.35–0.55 s apart, following the road that reaches it.
All motion settles by 2.65 s, leaving a 0.35 s final hold.
justifiedHolds: 2.65–3.0 s: settled view of the finished connected village, the result of the idea-to-system arc.

notes: Source-frame refresh: dusk violet-rose field over teal land with warm window accents, from BACKGROUND_REVIEW backgroundChoices; brush direction follows form (streaks for air, flames for the cypress, ruts for roads).
